item: K5, K7 and K8 read the last persisted measurement of their instrument (R706, open-on-main row 20, Lane T)
summary: The KPI board's _RESOLVERS held K2, K6 and K11 only, so keyword noise, date extraction and source health could never show a figure, though the date diagnostics had one (51.6%). Each instrument now writes down what it measured where it measures (never the KPI GET), one record per writer: the whole-corpus date diagnostics their coverage share (a filtered run records nothing), the full source audit its status counts, healthy share and per-region failing shares, and the keyword-engine run its generic-term list's size. K7 and K8 show the recorded share with the MEASUREMENT's date and age, verdict measured-no-bar (V1-6 sets the bar). K5 stays not measured: the instrument lists review candidates and measures no share, and the board computes none; its reason names the last run's date and list size. K7's source endpoint now names the real route, /api/diagnostics/dates.
